acceptanceResults: Release build jobs cannot consume platform helpers before the release_tools producer has completed; a regression asserts the dependency.
Source quality restores executable permissions after artifact download and validates the shared gate tool before expensive checks; a regression asserts the path contract.
The release-close embedded Bash is syntax-checked by the earliest release policy and produces a structured failed receipt when upstream jobs are skipped or inputs are absent.
The existing immutable v0.2.91 tag remains bound to e48a887d24f5e1a640ef9b043b60f6c4dca23a31; no tag movement or Release overwrite occurs.
Reviewed hosted CI passes, the corrected release path publishes v0.2.91, and public downloaded-artifact install and N-1 upgrade acceptance pass with cleanup evidence.
The workflow policy test extracts and syntax-checks the release-close script and rejects missing release_tools dependency or missing post-download chmod before hosted execution.

PR and post-merge quality routing selects the active Contract bound to the current PR branch or merge base when a predecessor and successor are both active, and fails closed on zero or ambiguous matches before expensive gates.

The read-only pre-execution Contract quality gate does not require lifecycle evidence that can only be produced by later release, public-adopter, close, or cleanup stages; lifecycle completion gates continue to enforce those evidence classes.
PR and release quality routes treat a missing .ai/work-items/active directory as an empty Contract set and remain compatible with repositories that have no active Work Item.

Pre-execution quality gates reuse the current canonical preflight decision binding rather than a stage-specific evidence projection; a matching human review remains valid across entry stages, while Contract or snapshot changes invalidate it fail-closed.

Candidate aggregation and post-publication helper checksum extraction use shell-valid awk source; the workflow policy regression rejects escaped-quote checksum expressions before hosted release execution.
